claim: The recurring affiliate credit-note job permanently starves due periods beyond its first 100.
OAuth login prevents existing plaintext affiliate profile data from being migrated.
A Twitch rename allows a second affiliate to reserve an already freshly claimed streamer.
IPv6 loopback configuration is incorrectly changed from HTTP to HTTPS in affiliate callback URLs.
Affiliate profile serialization panics when a stored Stripe account ID crosses a UTF-8 byte boundary.
Concurrent affiliate OAuth login can revert a successfully saved profile.
Affiliate profile migration can overwrite encrypted data saved after its initial selection.
Concurrent admin affiliate toggles lose one of the requested flips.
Affiliate APIs authorize account ownership by reusable Twitch login instead of immutable Twitch user ID.
The default commission page silently truncates the affiliate portal's lifetime earnings and commission history.
Affiliate recent-claim plan names are wrong for plans stored against a Twitch user ID.
Commission pagination overflows its signed offset and can return page one for an enormous page number.
Die Affiliate-Portal-API meldet fehlgeschlagene Statistikabfragen als erfolgreiche Nullsummen und leere Listen.
Der Affiliate-Konto-Lookup meldet Datenbankfehler fälschlich als HTTP 404 not_found.
The Stripe-connect redirect test races with the redirect configuration tests and can fail on correct code.
The affiliate OAuth callback test races with another test's master-key restoration and can unexpectedly return HTTP 503.
Profile lookup can select inactive partner history instead of the current active partner.
Bei fehlgeschlagenem Twitch-Streamplanabruf meldet der Profilimport trotzdem Erfolg.
The final public-profile visibility check can validate a different Twitch account and render the withdrawn original profile.
Upcoming stream dates use English weekday names on the German profile page.
Failed clip-contest session reads silently select a fallback Twitch submitter or report successful logged-out status.
Contest identity lookup failures are misreported as signed-out sessions and login-required errors.
A Discord vote can be accepted for an own clip when account linking completes while the vote waits for the month lock.
Rebinding a Discord account can make a below-quota submission collide with an occupied submission_slot.
A concurrent roadmap update can mark an unseen private reply to a bundled feedback entry as read.
Preauthorized camera peers can recreate a signaling room after permanent revocation.
Publisher-side permanent revocation can leave a replacement publisher streaming.
Stopping the camera can be undone by an in-flight device switch.
A stale WebSocket close callback can erase the replacement camera's video.
Overlapping overlay polls can replace newer statistics with an older response.
Caster cameras opened before initial consent remain black after consent is granted unless the scene is reloaded or reassigned.
Noncanonical external camera URLs cause the iframe to reload on every scene refresh.
Clearing the observer selection creates a false POV label in the caster preview.
Selecting a nondefault camera resets the selector to Standardkamera while retaining the selected camera stream.
Publisher setup sends ready even when saving camera consent fails.
Asynchronous initial camera connection failures leave the publish button disabled.
A slow camera subscriber permits unbounded signaling queues and dashboard-process memory exhaustion.
Uncapped public camera subscriptions exhaust the publisher's WebRTC peer resources.
Administrative camera revocation leaves normal subscriber WebSockets open indefinitely.
A concurrent publisher connection can undo permanent camera revocation and reactivate the revoked invitation.
Publisher self-revocation reports permanent success even when the database revocation fails.
A concurrent failed hero-icon refresh overwrites a successful cache and suppresses icons for six hours.
A null timestamp or KDA field in one Steam match discards the overlay's entire match history.
The overlay reports available history and a zero daily balance for Steam friendship errors.
Unauthenticated overlay requests can exhaust dashboard memory by creating cache entries that are never evicted.
Slow Kick/YouTube refresh responses lose newly issued credentials because the database transaction expires before the refresh deadline.
The Twitch token broker can return HTTP 200 with an already expired token after a slow failed refresh.
Twitch token snapshot reads can wait indefinitely outside the refresh timeout and exhaust the dashboard database pool.
The YouTube Uplink callback accepts Social Studio states and interprets numeric Twitch logins as another user's Twitch ID.
An acknowledged missing relay destination prevents platform disconnection and leaves it permanently pending.
YouTube stream selection ignores pagination and can choose a custom stream instead of the default stream.
Provider-controlled expires_in can panic in Kick and YouTube OAuth callbacks.
Stream-key generation-check database errors are incorrectly reported as no connection.
Kick and YouTube connection callbacks and stream-key requests can wait indefinitely for upstream HTTP responses.
Kick and YouTube OAuth callbacks permit account-linking CSRF because state is not bound to the initiating browser or session.
A persisted MessageId claim can acknowledge a notification that was never enqueued.
A failed stream.offline job is acknowledged on retry because its own offline throttle remains active.
An in-flight subscription-create response can overwrite a processed revocation and suppress subsequent resubscription.
Cleanup preserves disabled subscriptions and leaves their in-memory tracking active.
Deleting an old-callback subscription also untracks its retained current-callback twin.
Redelivery of stream.online overwrites a later completed stream.offline transition.
claim_or_extend exposes a deletion gap that can trigger a duplicate live announcement during an active cooldown.
stream.offline acknowledges failed session finalization and clears the session's recovery link.
Rehydration mistakes outgoing raid subscriptions for incoming raid subscriptions.
Database lookup failures can misclassify authorized chat channels as passive lurkers and skip both subscriptions.
Capacity snapshot database waits can stop the monitoring poller indefinitely.
Repeated webhook revocations can untrack an enabled replacement subscription.
Webhook timestamp validation accepts messages outside the declared 600-second window.
Expired inbox workers can resurrect delivered work as a dead-letter or overwrite newer retry state.
lease_due can return stream lifecycle events in reversed chronological order, leaving an offline broadcaster marked live.
Eine blockierte Inbox-Bestätigung kann den einzigen EventSub-Worker unbegrenzt anhalten.
The message-ID guard can acknowledge an EventSub delivery before durable acceptance, losing the event if the original attempt fails or crashes.
Unban cleanup errors are acknowledged without retry, leaving stale applied-ban entries that suppress subsequent offline sweeps.
An expired idempotency owner can delete a replacement owner's slot and overwrite its cached result.
Expiring an in-flight idempotency entry never publishes its timeout result to existing waiters.
An Origin host such as localhost,attacker.example is incorrectly classified as loopback.
The internal API origin guard accepts present Origin headers containing non-ASCII bytes.
Verify promotion and history reactivation can activate a partner after a concurrent signup block has committed.
Departnering can overwrite a concurrently saved Discord identity with stale profile data.
Concurrent verification backfills insert duplicate historical statistics despite the idempotency contract.
Concurrent archive or block toggles lose one of the requested state changes.
Verify promotion allocates partner IDs without advancing the sequence, causing subsequent OAuth signup to fail.
Departner retries skip raid-auth cleanup after a partial database failure.
Archived-partner retries cannot restore raid auth after partial reactivation.
Verify promotion can activate a streamer after a concurrent signup-denylist addition has committed.
Database fingerprints ignore SQLx host, port and dbname query overrides.
Leading whitespace in an accepted database URL causes a false fingerprint mismatch.
The internal legacy proxy follows redirects instead of forwarding their responses.
A failed current-session lookup makes chatters debug return historical-session chatters with HTTP 200.
Observability reports activeSessionCount=0 with HTTP 200 when the session-count query fails.
